blocks.text:
This repository keeps a Proofpress version ledger for Markdown knowledge
artifacts such as ADRs, design docs, PRDs, READMEs, and strategy notes. Never
snapshot source-code files; Git already owns that history.

After creating or substantially revising a Markdown knowledge artifact, close
the ledger loop before yielding:
1. If the artifact has Git history but no ledger entry, run
2. Preserve each surviving block's `[//]: # (ob:xxxxxxxx)` anchor while

editing. Drop anchors for deleted blocks and do not invent anchors for new
   blocks.
3. Run `python3 proofpress.py anchor <file>` and read the
4. Write temporary claims JSON with one honest entry per block touched or

removed. Do not enumerate untouched blocks. Use `unchanged` only as a
   deliberate negative claim about an important block or scope:
   `{"block":"<id>","kind":"added|removed|modified|moved|unchanged","note":"…"}`.
5. Snapshot with testimony. `--why` is required; add one `--rejected` for each

alternative actually considered and dropped:
   `python3 proofpress.py snapshot <file> --kind agent --author <agent> --session "<session-id>" --note "<changelog>" --claims <claims.json> --why "<reason>" --rejected "<option — reason dropped>"`.
6. Run `python3 proofpress.py verify <file>` and report its output verbatim.

Never re-snapshot merely to force a green result; a mismatch is reviewer
   information.
Repeat the loop for every Markdown knowledge artifact touched.
